content: MVP-grade inventory dashboards center on: stock-on-hand by SKU/product, low-stock alerts with configurable threshold, total inventory value, and search/filter by SKU or category. More advanced tiers add days-of-inventory-remaining, sell-through rate, purchase-order tracking, and drilldowns from category to SKU. Confirms low-stock alert + stock value + SKU search is the accepted 'minimum useful' bar, with turnover/sell-through/forecast as v2.
